name: Passkey.bond: Passkeys & 2FA
subtitle: Passkeys and 2FA codes
description:
Passkey.bond keeps your passkeys and two-factor authentication codes in an encrypted vault on your iPhone or iPad. Unlock it with Face ID, Touch ID, or your device passcode.

Create and use passkeys in Safari and supported apps through Password AutoFill. Add authenticator entries by scanning a QR code, pasting a setup link, or entering a setup key. Passkey.bond supports both time-based and counter-based codes.

Sync is optional. Link your devices with a recovery phrase to exchange end-to-end encrypted vault updates with Passkey.bond on your other devices, including the Chrome and Firefox extensions and the Android app, without creating a cloud account. Relay operators can see connection information, but vault contents are encrypted before they leave your device.

Export encrypted backups and restore them when needed. Keep your backup password and sync recovery phrase safe: nobody can recover them for you.

Passkey.bond is open source and a one-time purchase, with no subscription. It stores passkeys and authenticator codes, not account passwords.
price: US$2.95 one-time purchase (paid app, coming soon)
